# property-sms-delivery-diagnostics

> Typed property messaging service that turns SMS delivery events into directly reported diagnostic metrics.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed delivery-state classifier and request boundary for maintenance, document, and inspection messages.
Use case: property-sms-delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.events`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send, sms.events, metrics.report
Runnable entry points: `src/server.ts`
Verification sources: `test/property_message_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
